chansons.style: Melodic techno, driving 126 BPM kick, arpeggiated synths, emotional male vocal, euphoric build, dark atmospheric club ambiance

[Intro]
(Synth pulses)

[Chorus]
We fade away, we fade away
Nothing left for us to say
We fade away, we fade away
Dancing in the disarray
[Drop]
(Heavy techno beat)
[Verse 2]
I see your face in neon lights
But you're not here to share the nights
The rhythm takes my pain and flies
Into the empty, starless skies
I let the tempo wash the tears
Erasing all the wasted years
I'm stepping out into the rain
To wash away the lingering pain
[Pre-Chorus]
The bass is hitting like my heart
Tearing every piece apart
[Chorus]
We fade away, we fade away
Nothing left for us to say
We fade away, we fade away
Dancing in the disarray
[Bridge]
Let the synthesizer cry
Let the heavy basslines fly
I will leave you far behind
Peace is what I need to find
No more looking at the past
I'm moving forward, moving fast
The final beat is dropping down
I'm taking back my stolen crown
[Chorus]
We fade away, we fade away
Nothing left for us to say
[Outro]
Fading out...
Fading out...
